# Upstream screenshot fixtures

Source: https://github.com/valkia/aramgg_client/tree/e07cef86e7f88a16aa6046eabfc4cc7c4ab8da5a/tests/fixtures/augment-ocr

The three PNGs and manifest.json are unchanged copies of the reference project.
They exercise detection, partial OCR, false positives, monitor sizes and UI scale.
Tests use this local directory and require no sibling checkout.
